focused.label: The quiet operator
focused.description: A measured setup, a quiet fist raise, and a deliberate reset.

showboat.label: The lock-in showman
showboat.description: A bold entrance, a quick release, and a celebration worth watching.

goofball.label: The wildcard
goofball.description: Restless feet, an offbeat wind-up, and no poker face.

cool.label: The ice-cold closer
cool.description: An easy sway, an unhurried release, and a knowing lean after a make.

powerhouse.label: The powerhouse
powerhouse.description: A weighty landing and forceful setup, followed by a proud salute.

sharpshooter.label: The sharpshooter
sharpshooter.description: Watchful stillness, a clean snap, and a tiny acknowledgment.

hothead.label: The hothead
hothead.description: Fast feet, hard releases, and impatient pacing when it goes wrong.

trickster.label: The trickster
trickster.description: A twisting entrance, deceptive pause, and a cheeky bow.

veteran.label: The old hand
veteran.description: A grounded arrival, familiar rhythm, and a knowing reaction.

rookie.label: The eager rookie
rookie.description: An eager hop, nervous bob, and a surprised recoil after a miss.

showman.label: The headliner
showman.description: A paper twist, an expansive release, and a salute to the crowd.

stoic.label: The stone face
stoic.description: A planted stance, deliberate power, and almost no outward disappointment.

hype.label: The hype machine
hype.description: A springing entrance and rhythmic energy from first throw to last.

underdog.label: The scrappy underdog
underdog.description: A side-step arrival, a rocking wind-up, and a hard-earned fist raise.

perfectionist.label: The perfectionist
perfectionist.description: A watchful setup, exact timing, and a visibly deflated miss.

swagger.label: The swagger king
swagger.description: A sliding entrance, a loose stance, and a slow victory strut.

party-starter.label: The party starter
party-starter.description: A big pop, shuffling feet, and a celebration with its own beat.

comeback.label: The comeback kid
comeback.description: A springy arrival, a forceful release, and a grin-in-motion strut.

slow-burn.label: The slow burn
slow-burn.description: A quiet glide and a long wind-up, then a sudden celebratory pop.

live-wire.label: The live wire
live-wire.description: A ricochet entrance, tapping feet, and a whip-fast release.

zen.label: The zen master
zen.description: A gentle glide, pendulum rhythm, and a small gracious bow.

grinder.label: The relentless grinder
grinder.description: A heavy arrival and measured rhythm, with an impatient miss reset.

wildcard.label: The chaos merchant
wildcard.description: A twisting entry and offbeat body rhythm with an exaggerated finish.

captain.label: The clubhouse captain
captain.description: A confident landing, watchful stance, and a salute after a make.
